    n, D = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    superiors = [int(sys.stdin.readline()) for _ in range(n-1)]

    graph = defaultdict(list)
    for i, p in enumerate(superiors, start=2):
        graph[p].append(i)

    def dfs(node):
        if not graph[node]:
            return [1] * (D + 1)
        counts = [0] * (D + 1)
        for child in graph[node]:
            child_counts = dfs(child)
            new_counts = [0] * (D + 1)
            for d in range(1, D + 1):
                new_counts[d] = sum(child_counts[:d]) % MOD
            for d in range(1, D + 1):
                counts[d] = (counts[d] + new_counts[d]) % MOD
        return counts

    result = sum(dfs(1)[1:]) % MOD
    print(result)
